entries.proposition: THE PREMISE GOURLEY 2005 INHERITS, AND ITS AUTHORS' OWN CAVEAT ON IT: the exon 6-8-skipped transcript was called possibly cancer-associated only because normal surface epithelium and a 16-tissue normal panel showed full-length alone, and the same sentence says a larger normal panel is needed before calling the variants non-physiological. The later finding of the same transcript in 9 of 13 non-malignant ovaries fulfils this caveat rather than contradicting the paper.
entries.snippet: suggesting that the alternative transcripts B and D may be cancer-associated. However, screening of a larger panel of normal samples will be necessary to confirm that these splice variants are not physiological.
entries.anchor: Results, 'WWOX (FORII Transcript) Demonstrates Alternative Splicing', final two sentences

entries.proposition: THE SKIPPED TRANSCRIPT IS NOT ATTRIBUTABLE TO GENOMIC DELETION IN THE LINES THAT CARRY IT ALONGSIDE FULL LENGTH: heterozygosity for exon 6, 7 or 8 SNPs in the same lines makes single-allele exon loss unlikely, and the authors read the species as RNA processing.
entries.snippet: This suggests that, in these samples at least, the alternative transcripts were not caused by genomic deletion of exons on a single WWOX allele. It is therefore likely that these transcripts are produced by RNA processing

entries.proposition: WHAT THE PAPER DID MEASURE AS DELETION, with its denominators — the homozygous losses are in cell lines, each counted against the number of lines of that tumour type screened.
entries.snippet:
WX330 and NCI-H69 (2 of 12 small cell lung carcinoma cell lines
analyzed) showed homozygous deletion of exons 6–8, and PANC1 (1 of 2
pancreatic carcinoma cell lines screened) showed loss of exons 7–8.
entries.anchor: Results, 'The WWOX Gene Is Homozygously Deleted in Several Tumor Types'

entries.proposition: NO TRUNCATING POINT MUTATION WAS FOUND IN ANY OF THE SEQUENCED MATERIAL — the negative that makes deletion, not point mutation, this gene's inactivation mode in cancer, and the one a later reader must not convert into a statement about germline WWOX disease alleles.
entries.anchor: Results, 'Missense Polymorphisms Were Detected in Primary Tumors and Tumor Cell Lines'; the full clause reads 'Eleven polymorphisms (three silent and eight missense), but no truncating point mutations, were identified within the coding region of WWOX'

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S OWN FRAME FOR THE SKIPPING, which is the fragile site and not a splicing lesion: it draws the parallel with FHIT, where exon skipping by RT-PCR is frequent and inactivating point mutations are rare. Recorded because it bounds any transfer of 'aberrant WWOX transcript' language toward a splice-site disease allele.
entries.snippet: FHIT also exhibits a high frequency of alternative splicing because of exon skipping as detected by RT-PCR
